answer: A bond is refunded only after 43 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The atlas counter is kept in vertex and falcon publishes each reset. An adversary therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 43 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1192 identities would post 4378 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
